extracted.intended_audience: members of the press / journalists and media professionals seeking information from Habitat for Humanity of Greater Los Angeles
extracted.subtask_description: An organizational electronic press kit (EPK) page providing media assets, available expert topics, organizational facts and downloadable documents for journalists covering Habitat for Humanity of Greater Los Angeles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expert availability / spokesperson topics
rubrics_metrics.description: Our experts are available to the media on a wide array of topics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicitly lists topics the organization's experts will speak about: affordable housing, residential home construction and repairs, neighborhood revitalization, community development, volunteerism, philanthropy and nonprofit fundraising, disaster recovery and recycling with the Habitat LA ReStore.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media library: photo and video galleries
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a media library of photo and video galleries to illustrate work and impact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Page emphasizes visual assets and points journalists to galleries: 'Check out our media library of photo and video galleries to learn more about how Habitat LA offers a hand up, not a hand out!' Includes direct links labeled 'Click Here for Photos' and 'Click Here for Videos.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Organizational impact and milestone statistics
rubrics_metrics.description: Include concise impact metrics and milestone information to contextualize the organization's work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Page cites concrete facts for reporters: 'Over the last thirty years, Habitat LA has built, repaired or renovated over 1,000 homes locally, serving thousands of individuals and families in need of affordable housing.' Also notes the 30th anniversary in 2020 as a newsworthy milestone.

rubrics_metrics.name: Downloadable documents covering core story areas
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide downloadable documents that cover the organization's story, programs, and initiatives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Page lists specific document topics to include in the EPK: Our Story; Faith; Green Building; Habitat LA ReStores General Donations; Habitat LA ReStores Corporate Donations; Hollywood for Habitat for Humanity of Greater Los Angeles; Homeownership; Service Area; Sustainable Business Model; Veterans Initiative; Volunteer; Youth Programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Core messaging / positioning
rubrics_metrics.description: Clear, concise organizational message or positioning that journalists can quote or summarize.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Page communicates an accessible tagline/messaging about the organization's philosophy: 'Habitat LA offers a hand up, not a hand out!' This functions as recommended messaging for media use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accessibility for media inquiries
rubrics_metrics.description: Make it clear that media access is available and how the organization supports press needs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page opens by thanking media interest and stating availability: 'Thank you for your interest in Habitat for Humanity of Greater Los Angeles (Habitat LA). Our experts are available to the media...' which implies the EPK should include contact/access details and willingness to accommodate interviews and information requests.
